intro: Perth rewards visitors with beaches, river foreshore, and easy day trips to Rottnest and the Swan Valley. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Transperth trains run eight lines, every 5-10 min at peak and about 15 min off-peak.
Buses cover the CBD and suburbs; CAT buses are free on five colour-coded routes.
Pay with contactless card, a SmartRider card ($10), or a cash ticket.
A Go Anywhere fare is about $3.50 for three hours including transfers.
Uber and DiDi operate; taxis are Swan Taxis and Black and White.
A ferry links Elizabeth Quay to South Perth; bikes are barred on peak trains into the CBD.

fremantle-prison.name: Fremantle Prison
fremantle-prison.price_text: ≈ AUD 22–30 for a day tour; night tours cost more
fremantle-prison.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–17:00 · check tour times on the day
fremantle-prison.tip: Book the day tour online and arrive early; the tunnels tour needs closed shoes and sells out.

elizabeth-quay.name: Elizabeth Quay
elizabeth-quay.price_text: Free to walk; ferry and boat rides cost extra
elizabeth-quay.hours: Open 24 hours · cafes and bars have their own hours
elizabeth-quay.tip: Walk the loop past the bell tower and the bridge at sunset, then stay for dinner.

cottesloe-beach.name: Cottesloe Beach
cottesloe-beach.hours: Always open · patrolled by surf lifesavers in season
cottesloe-beach.tip: Swim between the flags. The grass terraces above the sand are the best sunset spot.

aqwa.name: AQWA (The Aquarium of Western Australia)
aqwa.price_text: ≈ AUD 30–40 adult; cheaper for children; check online
aqwa.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · last entry about an hour before close
aqwa.tip: The underwater tunnel is the highlight. Go early to beat school groups.

adventure-world.name: Adventure World
adventure-world.price_text: ≈ AUD 55–75 per person; book online for less
adventure-world.hours: Seasonal · usually closed in winter; check calendar on the day
adventure-world.tip: It is a full day out. Bring swimwear, sunscreen and a refillable bottle.

fishing-boat-harbour.name: Fremantle Fishing Boat Harbour
fishing-boat-harbour.price_text: Free to walk; fish and chips ≈ AUD 15–30
fishing-boat-harbour.hours: Always open · restaurants open lunch and dinner
fishing-boat-harbour.tip: Get fish and chips and eat outside by the boats. Seagulls are bold, so guard your food.

kalamunda-water-park.name: Kalamunda Water Park
kalamunda-water-park.hours: Seasonal summer opening · check days on the day
kalamunda-water-park.tip: It is small and family-focused. Check it is open before driving up the hills.

royal-showgrounds.name: Perth Royal Showgrounds
royal-showgrounds.price_text: ≈ AUD 25–40 entry; the Royal Show runs about a week each year
royal-showgrounds.hours: Event days only · check the show dates
royal-showgrounds.tip: The Royal Show is once a year in spring. Check dates before planning around it.

swan-river.name: Swan River
swan-river.hours: Always open · cruises run daytime and evening
swan-river.tip: Walk the South Perth foreshore for the best skyline view, or take a ferry across.

great-escape.name: The Great Escape Amusement Park
great-escape.price_text: ≈ AUD 30–50; check current prices and opening days
great-escape.hours: Check opening days on the day · often weekends and holidays
great-escape.tip: Smaller than Adventure World. Confirm it is open before you go.

uwa.name: University of Western Australia
uwa.hours: Campus grounds generally open daily · buildings have their own hours
uwa.tip: Walk down to the Sunken Garden and the river edge. It is a calm, green break from the city.

kings-park.name: Kings Park and Botanic Garden
kings-park.hours: Always open · visitor centre has daytime hours
kings-park.tip: Walk the Lotterywest Federation Walkway and stay for the skyline view at sunset.

fremantle-markets.name: Fremantle Markets
fremantle-markets.price_text: Free entry · food and goods cost extra
fremantle-markets.hours: Fri–Sun mainly · check hours on the day
fremantle-markets.tip: Come hungry for the food stalls. Go early on Saturday before it gets packed.

scarborough-beach.name: Scarborough Beach
scarborough-beach.tip: The esplanade has pools and cafes. Sunset here is a local ritual.

rottnest-day-trip.name: Rottnest Island day trip
rottnest-day-trip.price_text: ≈ AUD 90–150 return ferry; bike hire extra
rottnest-day-trip.hours: Ferries run morning and afternoon · book ahead
rottnest-day-trip.tip: Hire a bike and go early. Book the ferry online and take water and sunscreen.

swan-valley-tour.name: Swan Valley wine and food tour
swan-valley-tour.hours: Tours usually run daytime · book ahead
swan-valley-tour.tip: Book a tour with transport so nobody has to drive. Check tastings are included.

northbridge-walk.name: Northbridge food and bar walk
northbridge-walk.hours: Best from evening · many venues open late
northbridge-walk.tip: Start on William Street for Asian food, then wander to the small bars.

perth-mint.name: The Perth Mint
perth-mint.tip: The gold pour is the fun part. Book a tour slot rather than just walking in.

south-perth-foreshore.name: South Perth foreshore viewpoint
south-perth-foreshore.tip: Take the ferry from the city and walk the path for the classic skyline photo.

cbd-art-walk.name: Perth CBD street art and laneway walk
cbd-art-walk.price_text: Free to walk; guided tours ≈ AUD 30–50
cbd-art-walk.tip: Wander the small laneways off Murray and Hay Streets. Look up for murals.

stays.why: Walk to Elizabeth Quay, Kings Park and the free CAT buses. Best base if you have no car.
Next to the CBD and the heart of late-night food and bars. Good value and lively.
Historic port with markets, seafood and the ferry to Rottnest. A relaxed base 30 min by train from the CBD.
Beachfront stays with surf, pools and sunset bars. About 20–30 min by bus or car to the CBD.

food: Try local seafood: fish and chips at Fremantle or Hillarys, and WA rock lobster when in season.
Coffee is a local obsession. Small roasters and cafés are everywhere in Northbridge and Fremantle.
Northbridge and the CBD have cheap Asian eats — noodles, dumplings and Vietnamese — often AUD 15–25 a meal.
Book ahead for popular weekend brunches and seafood dinners, especially in summer.
Perth is spread out and kitchens close early by big-city standards. Eat before 9pm on weeknights.
more_time: Take the ferry or a fast boat to Rottnest Island for a full day of beaches and quokkas; book tickets ahead.
Swap a city day for the Swan Valley: vineyards and breweries about 30–40 min by car or train plus bus.
Add a day trip to the Pinnacles Desert in Nambung National Park; it is a long drive, so a tour is easier.
